note: Point scale: indicator inputs / 10, then × the pip. Gold pip 0.1. BTC auto pip assumed $1. Walk-forward is the app's 60/40 split. Tuning (which pre-specified variant, and a 0-bar vs 2-bar filter) is chosen on the train half only. real = Vantage round trip + slippage, skipping trades where that friction exceeds 25% of the stop. zero is the TradingView commission-0 slippage-0 book. forced pays the friction even when it exceeds the stop.

gold.note: The $5 stop clears a $0.35 gold round trip on every timeframe. Slippage of $0.10 makes the haircut 0.09R.

btc.assumption: Auto pip = $1 (dollar pip for a four-to-six-digit quote). Point = pip/10 = $0.10. Not the 0.01 mintick.
